reference: Look — they are posing in front of the waterfall right now.
sk: Pozri — práve teraz pózujú pred vodopádom.
cz: Podívej — právě teď pózují před vodopádem.

acceptable.text: Look, they are posing in front of the waterfall right now.
acceptable.normalized: look they are posing in front of the waterfall right now

mistakes.text: Look, they pose in front of the waterfall right now.
mistakes.normalized: look they pose in front of the waterfall right now
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Look“ a „right now“ ukazujú dej, ktorý práve prebieha: Present Continuous „are posing“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Look“ a „right now“ ukazují děj, který právě probíhá: Present Continuous „are posing“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Look” and “right now” show an action in progress: Present Continuous “are posing”.

mistakes.text: Look, they posing in front of the waterfall right now.
mistakes.normalized: look they posing in front of the waterfall right now
mistakes.feedback_sk: Present Continuous potrebuje pomocné sloveso: „they are posing“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Present Continuous potřebuje pomocné sloveso: „they are posing“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Present Continuous needs the helping verb “are”: “they are posing”.

mistakes.text: Look, they are posing in front the waterfall right now.
mistakes.normalized: look they are posing in front the waterfall right now
mistakes.feedback_sk: Predložka má tri slová: „in front of“ – „of“ nesmie chýbať.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Předložka má tři slova: „in front of“ – „of“ nesmí chybět.
mistakes.feedback_en: The preposition is “in front of”; “of” can't be left out.

mistakes.text: Look, they are posing in front of waterfall right now.
mistakes.normalized: look they are posing in front of waterfall right now
mistakes.feedback_sk: Chýba člen: „the waterfall“ – ide o konkrétny vodopád.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Chybí člen: „the waterfall“ – jde o konkrétní vodopád.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Waterfall” needs “the” because it is a specific one.

mistakes.text: Look, they are posing before the waterfall right now.
mistakes.normalized: look they are posing before the waterfall right now
mistakes.kind: before instead of in front of
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Before“ v zmysle miesta znie zastarano; bežne sa hovorí „in front of“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Before“ ve smyslu místa zní zastarale; běžně se říká „in front of“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Before” for place sounds old-fashioned; normally say “in front of”.
